question: A 30-year-old woman comes to the physician because of difficulty sleeping. She is afraid of falling asleep and gets up earlier than desired. Four months ago, she was the driver in a car accident that resulted in the death of her unborn child. She has vivid nightmares of the event and reports that she frequently re-experiences the accident. She blames herself for the death of her child, has stopped working as an accountant, avoids driving in cars, and has withdrawn from her parents and close friends. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
